scope: Jesus has six distinct body pictures; Look Unto Me has five.

placements.title: Meet the risen Savior
placements.description: The risen Christ extends an open hand to a man at Bountiful. One by one, the people may come near, see the marks of His sacrifice and know for themselves that He lives.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ in a charcoal mantle extending an open hand toward an elderly man in a courtyard

placements.title: Notice His pattern of prayer
placements.description: Jesus kneels beside an olive tree in quiet prayer. His repeated choice to withdraw and pray reveals communion with the Father as part of a life devoted to serving others.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ in a muted aubergine robe praying quietly beside an olive tree

placements.title: Welcome the children
placements.description: Jesus welcomes children and listens to them in a village courtyard. Mark's account shows the Savior defending their place near Him and receiving them with tenderness.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ in a petrol-teal robe listening warmly to children in a village courtyard

placements.title: Bring fear into the conversation
placements.description: Jesus listens to a frightened disciple as wind and waves surround their wooden boat. His calm attention meets the disciples' urgent fear before He stills the storm.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ wearing a textured sand-gray mantle with a brown woven edge, seated in a wooden boat and listening to a young disciple

placements.title: Harmony, Pennsylvania: a setting of revelation
placements.description: A quiet lane leads toward an interpretive early nineteenth-century farmhouse. The scene recalls rural Harmony, Pennsylvania, where Oliver Cowdery sought assurance and received the Lord's tender command to look to Christ in every thought.
placements.alt: An interpretive rural lane approaching a modest early nineteenth-century farmhouse

placements.title: Turn attention toward Christ
placements.description: Christ meets the viewer with a calm, reassuring gaze. In the quiet light of the setting sun, His expression offers a simple invitation: look to Him, remember His words and keep walking with faith.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ facing the viewer with a calm attentive expression

placements.title: Bring an honest question with you
placements.description: Beside the open scriptures, a woman pauses to write down a question she has not yet resolved. The wide ocean and quiet moment remind us that faith can keep growing even before every answer comes.
placements.alt: A woman recording a question beside an open book at a quiet overlook

placements.title: Talk about what you are learning
placements.description: A father and daughter share an unhurried conversation while washing dishes together. Faith becomes part of family life when we speak of Christ with warmth, listen to one another and learn side by side.
placements.alt: A father and adult daughter talking while washing dishes together

placements.title: Let study lead to something good
placements.description: A neighbor kneels to repair a small garden gate. The work is ordinary, but willing hands can answer the Lord's simple invitation to do good right where we are.
placements.alt: A neighbor helping repair a small garden gate
